description: Speech to text for AI agents, $0.30 per file: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC or WebM audio (max 5 MB, about 5 minutes) to a transcript with timed segments, detected language and optional WebVTT subtitles. One call: send a url or base64 — no upload step, no polling. No speech found means a 400 and you pay nothing. USDC on Base, no account, no API key.

file_base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded. Send this OR url.

filename.description: Optional original filename of file_base64 (its extension helps detect the type)

language.description: Optional 2-letter language code (e.g. 'en'); omit for auto-detect

media_type.description: Optional MIME type of file_base64 (helps tell DOCX/XLSX apart)

url.description: http(s) link to the file; we fetch it. Send this OR file_base64.

name: media_transcribe
